description: 12 facts that get explicitly dropped/retired/killed rather than replaced with a new value. Probes ask about current state; a stale answer means the memory kept treating the retired thing as active.

writes.text: Our cache layer is Redis.
We hold a Friday standup every week.
We officially support IE11 for enterprise customers.
External partners integrate against the v1 API.
Ops uses the legacy dashboard for incident triage.
The dark mode feature flag is enabled for all users.
The team hangs out in the #random-old Slack channel.
On-call carries a physical pager.
The team tracks tickets in Jira.
We're subscribed to the vendor's monthly newsletter.
The product offers a free tier for individuals.
We have a satellite office in Austin.
Quiet week, mostly code review and backlog grooming.
We dropped the Redis cache last quarter; reads now hit Postgres directly, no separate cache layer.
We cancelled the Friday standup; the team only does Monday and Wednesday syncs now.
Onboarded a new support rep this week.
We dropped IE11 support entirely - the app requires an evergreen browser now.
The v1 API is deprecated and shut off; partners must use v2.
Spent the afternoon triaging a batch of stale GitHub issues.
The legacy dashboard was sunset; incident triage moved to the new Grafana board.
We turned off the dark mode feature flag after a contrast bug; it's disabled for everyone now.
We archived #random-old; casual chat moved to #watercooler.
Deployed a small fix to the invoice PDF renderer.
We retired the physical pager; on-call alerts go through PagerDuty on our phones now.
We stopped using Jira for ticket tracking; everything moved to Linear.
We unsubscribed from the vendor newsletter after the pricing spam.
We killed the free tier; every account now requires a paid plan.
We closed the Austin office; the whole team is remote now.

probes.question: Do we still use Redis as our cache layer?
Is there a Friday standup?
must_not_contain: hold a Friday standup every week

probes.question: Which API version should partners integrate against?
must_not_contain: partners integrate against the v1 API

probes.question: What does ops use for incident triage?
must_not_contain: uses the legacy dashboard for incident triage

probes.question: Is the dark mode feature flag still on?
expected: turned off the dark mode feature flag
must_not_contain: feature flag is enabled for all users

probes.question: Where does the team chat casually on Slack?
must_not_contain: hangs out in the #random-old Slack channel

probes.question: Does on-call still carry a physical pager?
What tool does the team use to track tickets?
Are we still subscribed to the vendor newsletter?
must_not_contain: subscribed to the vendor's monthly newsletter

probes.question: Does the product still have a free tier?
must_not_contain: offers a free tier for individuals

probes.question: Do we still have an office in Austin?
